name: Weather
description: Complete forecasts with multiple locations: today or the whole week, hour by hour, wind, air quality, humidity, pressure, UV, pollen, sunrise and sunset, moon phases. Opens from a question about the weather.
capabilities: Detailed day view and weekly view, chosen from the question
Hour by hour: temperature, rain, wind, gusts, UV, cloud and visibility
European and US air quality, fine particles, gases and pollen
Pressure with trend, dew point, humidity and feels-like temperature
Sunrise, sunset, day length, sunshine hours and moon phase
Several saved locations with a default, and units of your choice
